name: forge-agent-cli
description: forge ∞ — unified cognitive engineering intelligence. v113 githubwise: GitHub inspect via gh CLI is evidence for the governor; push/PR stay gitship. Built on v112 criticwise: doomed edits/thrash/secrets BLOCK on the default path (MICRO advisory). Built on v111 jointwise: one route scores depth+model+skill together; MICRO/lock/named still win. Built on v110 modelwise: selectModel runs on the live path (cycle broken); MICRO never steals the caller's model; measured history can switch. Built on v109 metawise: reasoning depth is learned from outcomes (cheaper-if-equal; MICRO never escalates; env drift discounts old stats). Built on v108 performwise: SEARCH actually greps; created tools search the tree; failover ranks by empirics. Built on v107 createwise: repeated capability gap → design/implement/verify/activate on the live path; created tools join routing and caplearn. Built on v106 capabilitywise: measured capability health changes the next route; knowledge gaps feed SEARCH; free knowledge is cheapest-acquire not random research. Built on v105 routewise: smart skill/MCP router (klass budgets, quality gate, inspect withholds mutating MCP, catalog recommends — never auto-installs). Built on v104 bindwise: wire the gaps (honest covering checks, recorded VOI experiments, ranked PLAN strategies, world-model testsFor/invalidate on the live path). Built on v103 learnwise: self-model from measured evidence, changed instructions invalidate the plan (v1 frozen), cheapest VOI experiment before another patch (never auto-switch models). Built on v102 intelwise: predict → observe → calibrate on the DEFAULT agent path (deterministic file prediction, drift MISS→REPLAN, cheapest-first router, empirics recorded). Built on v101 authoritywise: the governor CONTROLS the live loop (ASK pauses as WAITING_FOR_USER; VERIFY/INSPECT hide writes on MEDIUM+; STOP ends the run; per-step directive). Built on v100 cognitionwise: ONE cognitive core on the DEFAULT agent path (user model + task contract + governor + omega kernel share state; governor chooses the next cognitive action; original intent is frozen; implemented ≠ verified; no silent goal substitution). Built on v99 loopwise (the agency release: THE STOP FIX — the direct one-shot agent no longer halts dead at its step budget: while a run is PRODUCTIVE (fresh writes, passing checks, diverse tool use, no signature loop) its step AND tool-call budgets auto-extend in bounded increments up to the same hard caps, with visible step_budget_extended events and honest INCOMPLETE+checkpoint when it stalls — while the meta-side segment table doubles its bases so a healthy run is no longer interrupted every ~25 steps; THE REVIEWER — codereview.js gives every mutating segment ONE bounded read-only review of the ACTUAL change (working diff vs HEAD, LSP diagnostics, failing ledger evidence, secret/smell scan of ADDED lines): deterministic findings stand alone, a reviewer agent pass adds strict-JSON findings, blockers become required actions that drive repair, CODE_REVIEW_* events persist, and the v94 stale-required-action deadlock is fixed (recurring actions are re-derived per attempt, never sticky); THE FIXER — repairSegment now receives a structured DEFECT REPORT (live LSP diagnostics, failing verification records, the read-only verifier's own report) plus a deterministic autofix fast path: lint/format-class failures get the project's OWN allowlisted, shellguard-safe formatter ONCE before any LLM tokens are spent, with ledger evidence either way; THE PLANNER — plancritique.js is the quality gate the planner lacked: coverage vs the objective's own terms, granularity, verification-step presence, read-only balance — one bounded revision pass when majors exist, adopted only if it re-validates AND beats the original score; REACH — a curated MCP catalog (100 ranked GitHub-backed servers, forge mcp add/catalog/remove, secrets never invented) and a skill registry (best GitHub skill repos with ready raw URLs, forge skill search/recommend) plus 4 new bundled skills (code-reviewer, perf-tuning, api-design, data-migration); DELIVERY — gitship.pr=gh opens real pull requests through the user's OWN gh CLI (passthrough, never a forge-held token, consent-gated like push)) on v98 shipwise.
